definitions.gloss: sense of camaraderie; solidarity; fellow feeling; group consciousness
definitions.explanation: The feeling of belonging to a group and identifying with its members. Can be positive (team spirit) or negative (exclusionary in-group mentality).

examples.japanese: {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a team with a strong sense of camaraderie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合宿|がっしゅく}→合宿：11901_gasshuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}じて{仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Our sense of solidarity deepened through the training camp.

examples.japanese: {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If the group consciousness is too strong, it can become difficult to accept outsiders.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧ (companion, fellow member) and ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (consciousness, awareness). Describes the psychological bond within a group. While often used positively to describe team spirit, it can also refer to exclusionary cliquishness when carried too far.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have a strong sense of camaraderie
- {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to strengthen group solidarity
- {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: a sense of camaraderie develops
- {仲間|なかま}{意識|いしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have a sense of belonging

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連帯感|れんたいかん}→連帯感：19554_rentaikan⟧: sense of solidarity — more formal, emphasizes mutual support and unity
- ⟦{帰属意識|きぞくいしき}→帰属意識：18143_kizokuishiki⟧: sense of belonging — focuses on identifying with an organization or community
- ⟦{一体感|いったいかん}→一体感：06250_ittaikan⟧: sense of unity — feeling of being one with a group, often in collective experiences
